headline: Medium-risk shared-file and clipboard pathways: Airflow can feed content into ChatGPT Desktop, creating prompt-injection, leakage, and cascading-error exposure.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Airflow has broad network egress and can surface externally sourced content, while ChatGPT Desktop reads files, clipboard, and app context. That creates a default pathway where attacker-controlled Airflow outputs can be pasted or opened into ChatGPT and interpreted as instructions. The interaction is plausible without special tooling, though not fully automatic.
conditions: IF Airflow output is copied into ChatGPT Desktop via clipboard or file import
IF ChatGPT Desktop is used to summarize or act on untrusted Airflow-generated text
mitigations: Use a strict copy/paste policy for Airflow outputs
Strip instructions from Airflow-generated text before review
Open untrusted files in a plain-text viewer first
Disable clipboard bridging during analysis sessions
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to Airflow outputs

B_data_leakage.rationale: Airflow can reach external services, and ChatGPT Desktop ingests uploaded files and files from supported macOS apps. If Airflow workflows contain sensitive data, moving those artifacts into ChatGPT Desktop can expose them to OpenAI processing. The profiles do not show a shared filesystem by default, so the risk is mediated by user workflow rather than automatic host sharing.
conditions: IF Airflow tasks produce files containing sensitive data
IF those files are uploaded to or opened by ChatGPT Desktop
mitigations: Classify Airflow outputs before sharing
Redact secrets from exported artifacts
Use synthetic samples for ChatGPT review
Keep sensitive DAG outputs out of shared folders
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on exported pipeline artifacts

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airflow is a data-engineering orchestrator, while ChatGPT Desktop has read-only filesystem access and no write_filesystem or modify_git_state capability. Their write surfaces do not overlap in the profiles, so direct resource contention is limited. Any conflict would require unusual external coordination not shown here.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator grants both agents write access to the same mutable resource
IF Airflow outputs are used to drive edits in another tool
mitigations: Keep ChatGPT Desktop in read-only review mode
Separate working directories for pipeline artifacts
Avoid concurrent edits to shared repos
requires-engineering: add locking around shared mutable resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airflow can generate operational outputs, and ChatGPT Desktop can consume files, screenshots, and app context. If ChatGPT treats Airflow-produced text as authoritative, errors can cascade from pipeline diagnostics into incorrect summaries or actions. The profiles do not show automatic action-taking, so the blast radius is bounded but still meaningful.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop is asked to act on Airflow logs or reports without verification
IF Airflow outputs contain stale or partial pipeline state
mitigations: Require source verification for every Airflow-derived claim
Compare outputs against raw logs before acting
Use a second reviewer for operational decisions
Mark generated summaries as non-authoritative
requires-engineering: add citation checks in the workflow

E_compliance.rationale: Airflow is source-available and does not list touched data classes, while ChatGPT Desktop explicitly touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code. No residency or certification mismatch is documented in the profiles, so only a limited compliance concern exists if regulated data is moved from Airflow into ChatGPT Desktop. The other agent is cited because the compliance exposure arises at the handoff.
conditions: IF regulated data from Airflow is exported into ChatGPT Desktop
IF the exported data is subject to stricter residency or retention rules than OpenAI processing
mitigations: Avoid exporting regulated data to ChatGPT Desktop
Use de-identified samples for review
Document the data-handling boundary
Check retention settings before upload
requires-engineering: route regulated workloads to a compliant environment
